notes.title: Big update for Leak.Prolog.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

1. Corrected the landscape display at minimum settings
2. Improved models and textures of some items
3. Updated models and textures for the facade of the house
4. Updated models and textures for the facade and interior of the garage
5. Improved lighting
6. Added a new screamer and improved some previous screamers
7. Improved sound design
8. Improved menu screensavers
9. Improved some visual effects
10. Improved some cutscenes
11. Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: Major update for Leak. Prologue.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

1. Added a dynamic weather system
2. Landscape and vegetation on maps have been completely redesigned
3. Improved lighting
4. Added a new monster — the Forest Spirit
5. New animations for the monster
5. New visual effects
6. Improved/replaced models and textures
7. Improvements in cutscenes
8. Added jump scares
9. Improved sound design

Other changes:
1. The logic of the appearance of monsters and jump scares has been reworked
2. Improved and more comprehensive graphics settings interface
3. Added mouse inversion
4. Added DLSS 3
5. Improved item physics

notes.title: Big update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Changes:
[olist]
 Added an option to choose difficulty.
 Added new screamers an monsters.
 Improved hint system for interacting with items.
 Added new hints for certain puzzles.
 Changed the location of certain items.
 Several cutscenes were improved.
 Reduced loading time when travelling between locations.
 Improved game performance. 
 Added new models and textures.
 Improved tutorial to make it more intuitive.
 Improved autosaving.
 Interfaces adapted to 21:9 aspect ratio.
 Fixed bugs.

notes.title: Hotfix #7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:


 Added notification of a new entry in the book
 Improved the logic of the occurrence of the monster
 Improved monster behavior during pursuit
 Improved the work of the loading screen
 Added new animations to the loading screen
 Improved monster animation
 Improved the behavior of the camera and doors during some cutscenes

notes.title: Hotfix #6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:


Increased the range of interaction with hints from the riddle about planets
Fixed the point disappearing after the hint banner
Improved description of some hint banners
Improved the appearance of the monster during the chase.
Added smoke to the monster when playing on dx11
Fixed a bug where it was possible to control the character's camera during the fall
Reduced the minimum speed for footstep sounds
Improved monster spawn system
Improved the order in which some hints appear

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:

 The name of the gasoline canister has been corrected
 Improved tip text in loading screens
 Fixed the occurrence of apples after loading the save
 Changed the location of one of the pages of the book, now it is easier to see
 Fixed a bug that caused the page texture to change during its pick-up
 One of the screemers has been redesigned in such a way that players will now not be able to miss it if activated.

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:


 Objects in the hands no longer cast shadows
 Now the notes are aligned with the text to the camera during the inspection
 The note about the swan is now called “The Riddle about the Swan”
 Changed the logic of the appearance of some screamers
 Added the ability to view controls for gamepads using the keyboard
 The first training banner has been changed
 Fixed a phenomenon in which the monster did not move after appearing

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:


 Auto-save by time will no longer work on the lake
 The ability to read the book has been added to the autumn location
 Added a warning window about additional content
  Improved localization of the note about the swan
 Fixed the translation error of the riddle under the tree
 Now, during the first opening of the book, after finding a new page, the ability to scroll will appear after 3 seconds.
 Now all pages are picked up in the order of their location in the book
 Improved the flight of the picked up items
 Fixed the camera position when opening the window

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:


 Fixed a bug where it was possible to save the game while being killed by a monster
 Fixed a bug that led to the ability to load onto a map with a large monster
 The animation of the appearance of a snowdrift has been optimized.
 Fixed that there was no fire at the snowdrift on DX11
 The molten snowdrift mesh is optimized.
 Optimized animation of the fence appearance.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Gameplay fixes:
